exact_statement: For F=sum_j C_j u_j with a finite exclusive controller partition and pairwise disjoint independent Boolean data cores, every finite adaptive physical tree interleaving data and controller queries admits U=sum q_j[H(u_j)-eta(m_j^2)] and R=sum q_j log2(1/q_j)(1-m_j^2). At a controller query, U is a martingale and kappa=R-E R_child=sum_j q_j V_j D_2(P(X|C_j)||uniform)>=0. At a data query in core j, R-E R_child=q_j log2(1/q_j)beta_j^2 and D_iH(F)<=U+R-E(U_child+R_child)+(3/ln2)q_j beta_j^2. Hence R_root=E R_leaf+sum_data w q_j log2(1/q_j)beta_j^2+sum_controller w kappa, and sum_data w cap+E R_leaf+sum_controller w kappa<=((1+2/e)/ln2)Pi_data+R_root, with R_root<=2I_ctrl(root). The full stopped entropy bound retains E H(F_leaf), U_root-E U_leaf, R_root-E R_leaf and sum_controller w(DH-kappa); no universal price for that residual is asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform physical cube; independent disjoint controller and data blocks, each selected core on its own physical cube; Boolean sign outputs.
Exclusive selector indicators C_j partition controller assignments; constant output states and biased core outputs are permitted.
Each adaptive tree step queries one currently unrevealed physical coordinate and children have fair reach probabilities; arbitrary stopping frontiers and interleavings.
H, eta and KL use bits; eta(x)=x log2(1/x). Endpoint caps and zero-probability terms are zero. Shared physical DATA between cores is excluded.
